content: I'll split this bead into 4 focused, sequential child beads covering config schema, routing logic, dispatch integration, and testing/docs.

args.command:
br create "Add routing config schema to NEEDLE" "## Scope
Add config schema for model-based adapter routing: \`agent.routing\` (ordered list of {model_pattern, adapter} rules, first-match-wins) and \`default_adapter\` fallback. Support workspace override via .needle.yaml.

## Implementation
1. Extend config schema in \`src/config/mod.rs\`:
   - Add \`routing: Vec<RoutingRule>\` field where \`RoutingRule\` has \`model_pattern: String\` and \`adapter: String\`
   - Add \`default_adapter: String\` field (default: \"claude-code-glm-4.7\")
2. Parse routing from .needle.yaml workspace config (workspace overrides global)
3. Emit config-change telemetry when routing is loaded

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Config struct includes routing and default_adapter fields
- [ ] YAML parsing handles empty/missing routing gracefully (uses default_adapter)
- [ ] Workspace .needle.yaml routing rules merge with global config
- [ ] cargo build succeeds"
args.description: Create first child bead: config schema

args.command:
br create "Implement routing rule matcher" "## Scope
Implement pattern matching logic for routing rules: regex/glob patterns against model names, first-match-wins semantics, workspace override, default fallback.

## Implementation
1. Create \`src/routing.rs\` module with \`match_adapter(model: &str, rules: &[RoutingRule], default: &str) -> Option<String>\`
2. Support both regex (r\"...\") and glob (\"*\", \"**\") patterns in model_pattern
3. Return first matching adapter name or default fallback
4. Add unit tests: pattern matching, first-match-wins, no-match-fallback, invalid-pattern-graceful-fail

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] match_adapter returns Some(adapter) on match, None on no-match (caller uses default)
- [ ] First match wins regardless of later more-specific matches
- [ ] Unit tests cover: regex patterns, glob patterns, first-match-wins, empty rules, no-match
- [ ] cargo test passes"

args.command:
br create "Wire routing into dispatch with telemetry" "## Scope
Apply routing in Worker::resolve_adapter and dispatch path. Emit routing-decision telemetry event (model, matched rule, chosen adapter). NO silent fallback to claude-sonnet builtin.

## Implementation
1. Modify \`src/worker/mod.rs\` resolve_adapter() to:
   - Check config.routing rules when model is requested
   - Call routing matcher to get adapter name
   - Resolve adapter by name (not hardcoded to default)
   - Emit telemetry: \`RoutingDecision { model, rule, adapter }\`
2. Fail loudly if routed adapter is missing (complements bf-14w/bf-2wi, do not duplicate)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Requesting sonnet/opus/fable/haiku routes to claude-print (if configured)
- [ ] Requesting glm-4.7 routes to claude-code-glm-4.7
- [ ] Telemetry emitted on every routing decision
- [ ] Missing routed adapter returns Error (not silent fallback)
- [ ] cargo build succeeds"

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] docs/plan.md documents routing policy and June 15 deadline

- [ ] All tests green (cargo + clippy)"
